step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified all architecture components from visual elements and audio description:
   - Kinesis Data Streams (ingest real-time streaming data from manufacturing line)
   - Kinesis Data Firehose (stream raw data to S3)
   - Processing Stage Lambda (daisy-chained processing stages: parse, enrich, normalize)
   - DynamoDB (intermediate state and trigger for pipeline stages/ auxiliary functions via DynamoDB Streams)
   - Auxiliary Lambdas (persist processing results to secondary stores)
   - Aurora (Serverless SQL data store for users/SQL reporting)
   - Elasticsearch / OpenSearch (for real-time dashboards)
   - S3 (central raw and processed data lake store)
   - AWS Glue (scheduled batch processing jobs over S3 data)
   - Athena (ad-hoc SQL queries directly over S3 data)
2. Evaluated logical flows:
   - Flow 0: Ingestion and multi-stage processing pipeline triggering auxiliary lambdas to output to Aurora, Elasticsearch, and S3.
   - Flow 1: Direct archival via Kinesis Firehose to S3.
   - Flow 2: Analytics and batch processing on S3 via Glue and Athena.
3. Verified all services against the allowed vocabulary and mapped Elasticsearch to OpenSearch.

graph.name: HP Real-Time Cartridge Manufacturing Data Pipeline Architecture
graph.notes: Real-time streaming pipeline processing ink cartridge manufacturing data, using Kinesis Data Streams, multi-stage Lambda processing, DynamoDB streams, Aurora Serverless, Elasticsearch, S3, Glue, and Athena.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Streams
nodes.notes: Ingests real-time streams generated by manufacturing machines.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
nodes.notes: Streams raw incoming data directly into S3 for archival and batch processing.

nodes.name: Processing Stage Lambda
nodes.notes: Daisy-chained processing stages: Parse, Enrich with reference data, Normalize data model.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores intermediate state between stages; DynamoDB Streams trigger subsequent stages and auxiliary Lambdas.

nodes.name: Auxiliary Lambdas
nodes.notes: Triggered by DynamoDB Streams to persist processed data to Aurora, Elasticsearch, and S3.

nodes.name: Aurora
nodes.notes: Aurora Serverless used for SQL users and reporting via Data API.

nodes.name: Elasticsearch
nodes.notes: Provides real-time dashboards for tracking part positions across manufacturing lifecycle.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Data lake store for bulk raw and processed data.

nodes.name: AWS Glue
nodes.notes: Scheduled bulk processing jobs running on 6-hourly to daily interval over S3 data.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Enables ad-hoc SQL queries on top of data stored in S3.

edges.notes: Kinesis streams real-time data to the processing unit Lambda.
Processing Lambda saves parsed/enriched stage data to DynamoDB.
DynamoDB Streams trigger auxiliary Lambdas for persistence to downstream stores.
Auxiliary Lambdas write data into Aurora Serverless via Data API.
Auxiliary Lambdas persist data into Elasticsearch for real-time dashboards.
Auxiliary Lambdas persist processed data into S3 storage.
Kinesis Firehose streams raw data straight to S3 bucket.
Glue scheduled batch ETL jobs process bulk data stored in S3.
Athena queries data stored in S3 bucket.
